The Port Macquarie Base Hospital paediatric service is supported by a dedicated team of junior medical officers, with 24-hour onsite JMO coverage available to assist the consultant at all times. The locum specialist will undertake daily ward rounds and provide on-call coverage across the full 24-hour period of each rostered day, with the expectation of re-attending the hospital as required for clinical reviews or emergencies.
